indoor_dry.instructions: Is the concrete inside a building, in a dry space protected from rain and frost?

rain.instructions: Is the concrete surface exposed to rain or splash water outdoors?

ground.instructions: Is the concrete buried in soil or permanently in contact with the ground?

frost.instructions: Can the concrete freeze while wet in winter?

deicing_salt.instructions: Will de-icing salt or salty meltwater reach the concrete, for example on a driveway, road, garage or parking area?

horizontal.instructions: Is the exposed surface horizontal, so that water or snow can lie on it?

reinforced.instructions: Will the concrete contain steel reinforcement such as rebar or mesh?

watertight.instructions: Must the concrete hold back water, as in a basement in groundwater, a pond, a pool or a tank?

traffic.instructions: What traffic or wear will the surface carry?
criteria: none: nobody walks or drives on it
cars: cars or light vehicles drive or park on it
heavy: trucks, forklifts or industrial wear

element.instructions: What kind of concrete element is described?

criteria.foundation: strip or pad footing, post base, foundation for a shed, wall or machine
criteria.slab: floor slab, base plate, garage floor, terrace slab, ceiling
criteria.wall: wall, column, beam, lintel, ring beam, retaining wall, stairs
criteria.small: fence posts, small casts, planters, garden decoration

fine_cast.instructions: Is this a DIY decorative or furniture piece (table top, planter, bowl, sink, lamp, bench) cast from fine mortar, rather than structural or site concrete?

approach.instructions: How does the person want to make the concrete?

criteria.scratch: mix it from scratch: buy cement, sand and gravel separately, or order site or ready-mixed truck concrete
criteria.bagged: start from a bag of ready-mixed dry concrete from the DIY store and add things like cement, a waterproofer or water
criteria.fine_mortar: a thin-walled DIY or designer piece cast from a fine or high-strength mortar

add_cement.instructions: Does the person want to add extra cement to a mix to make it stronger?

add_plasticizer.instructions: Does the person want a more flowable mix or a plasticiser or superplasticiser?

shape.instructions: What shape is the concrete piece?

criteria.slab: flat slab, plate, floor, table top, path or driveway: area times thickness
criteria.block: solid block or cuboid, a foundation or post hole
criteria.cylinder: solid round post, column, round foundation or round hole
criteria.hollow: hollow body with walls: planter, pot, box, trough, seat cube, sink
criteria.ring: ring, pipe or frame open at both ends

open_sides.instructions: If the piece is hollow, how many sides are open?

criteria.one: one side open, like a planter open at the top or a seat cube open at the bottom
criteria.both: open at both ends, like a pipe or ring
